## ESLint Config Contributor Notes

- [ ] Keep the PR title/body and all commits public-safe; do not include
      non-public references, private links, private tracking IDs, or private
      consumer context
- [ ] Verify the PR title is correct because it becomes the squashed commit
      title and drives semantic-release; see the
      [README release process](../README.md#release-process)
- [ ] Use a release-triggering PR title only when this should publish a
      consumer-facing package release
- [ ] Add or update examples/tests when changing shared rule behavior or
      published config exports
- [ ] Confirm README usage examples and published package paths stay aligned
